capabilities: capture visible screen text into structured Markdown notes
chat with vault notes via local semantic search
auto-fill web form fields with vault data
query the vault from a floating overlay drawer
extras: Freemium: free tier allows 15 screen snaps and 10 form-fill automations; Pro is $39 lifetime or $6 monthly. Installed by cloning the repository and running npm install, not via the community plugin store.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in AI assistant, and reusing vault facts in outside windows or capturing on-screen content requires manual copying and typing.

relations.evidence: Query your knowledge base conversationally via the floating drawer powered by Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite.

summary: AI copilot with a floating Dynamic Island overlay for chatting with your vault, capturing screen content into notes, and auto-filling web forms.
